text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month and nine-month treasury bills rose from the last sale on March 25, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Six-month bills edged up to 30.23 percent from 30.13 percent and nine-month bills firmed to 32.78 percent from 32.72 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 116 112
Issue date March 26, 1997 March 25, 1997
Maturity date September 24, 1997 September 24, 1997
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume 6.00 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 5.99 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.20 million UAH 17.39 million UAH
Average yield 30.23 percent 30.13 percent
Average price 86.90 hryvnia 86.94 hryvnia
Cut-off price 86.86 hryvnia 86.86 hryvnia
The central bank sold 59,894 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 27.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Auction Number 117 113
Issue date March 26, 1997 March 25, 1997
Maturity date December 24, 1997 December 24, 1997
Denominations 100 hryvnia 100 hryvnia
Issue volume 12.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 11.73 million UAH 59.69 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.42 million UAH 47.96 million UAH
Average yield 32.78 percent 32.72 percent
Average price 80.31 hryvnia 80.34 hryvnia
Cut-off price 80.20 hryvnia 80.20 hryvnia
The central bank sold 117,289 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 27.
Three-month and 12-month T-bill auctions were cancelled without explanation.
